payload.name: DeeplyClear
payload.description: 创建可分享的思维导图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DeeplyClear is an interactive mind map and visual thinking tool that turns complex ideas, conversations, research, notes, plans, documents, and codebases into editable, shareable mindmaps and visual knowledge maps.

Use DeeplyClear to organize ideas, create concept maps, explore systems and relationships, clarify arguments, map research, understand codebases, and transform complicated information into clear visual structures.
payload.longDescription:
DeeplyClear 是一款互动式思维导图和视觉思考工具，可将复杂想法、对话、研究、笔记、计划、文档和代码库转化为可编辑、可分享的思维导图和视觉知识图谱。

使用 DeeplyClear 整理想法、创建概念图、探索系统及其关系、梳理论证、绘制研究图谱、理解代码库，并将复杂信息转化为清晰的可视结构。

payload.name: Productive
payload.summaryOriginal: Run your work in one place
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Productive app connects OpenAI to your Productive organization, giving you conversational access to your operations platform.

Productive is built for professional services teams - agencies, consultancies, and software companies, to manage projects, track time, plan resources, and oversee finances. With this connector, you can query and act on that data directly from ChatGPT, without switching tools.

Ask about team availability, budget utilization, overdue tasks, or pipeline status, and get instant answers grounded in your live Productive data.
payload.longDescription:
该插件在一个地方管理工作。以下功能和限制适用：

The Productive app connects OpenAI to your Productive organization, giving you conversational access to your operations platform.

Productive is built for professional services teams - agencies, consultancies, and software companies, to manage projects, track time, plan resources, and oversee finances. With this connector, you can query and act on that data directly from ChatGPT, without switching tools.
Ask about team availability, budget utilization, overdue tasks, or pipeline status, and get instant answers grounded in your live Productive data.

payload.name: PomoDial
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PomoDial is a Pomodoro focus timer that asks what you're working on before the clock starts. Tell ChatGPT your intention, start a timed session, and PomoDial tracks your focus history, streaks, and progress. Sessions sync with your account at pomodial.com where you can view your intention journal, unlock dial faces, and compete on the leaderboard.
payload.longDescription: PomoDial 是一款番茄钟专注计时器，会在计时开始前询问您正在做什么。告诉 ChatGPT 您的目标，开始计时后，PomoDial 会追踪专注历史、连续记录和进度。会话会同步到您在 pomodial.com 的账户，您可以在那里查看目标日志、解锁表盘并参与排行榜竞争。

payload.name: Codex Tasks (Internal/CCA)
payload.description: 内部 CCA 任务适配器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Delegate code tasks to registered Codex environments.
payload.longDescription: 将代码任务委派给已注册的 Codex 环境。

payload.name: Meeting Summarizer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meeting Summarizer by Chat Everywhere helps users find past meetings, retrieve summaries, reports, and mind maps, search timestamped transcript evidence, and use that context to prepare follow-ups and drafts in ChatGPT. Access is limited to meetings owned by the authenticated eligible account.
payload.longDescription: Chat Everywhere 出品的 Meeting Summarizer 帮助用户查找过往会议、调取摘要、报告和思维导图、搜索带时间戳的文字记录证据，并在 ChatGPT 中利用这些上下文准备后续跟进和草稿。访问范围仅限于经过身份验证且符合条件的账户所拥有的会议。

payload.name: ApplyArc
payload.description: 简历评分、求职信与面试准备
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Know what your CV or resume actually proves before you apply. Paste a job post and your CV, or attach one PDF/DOCX resume. ApplyArc maps each stated requirement to exact CV evidence, shows honest gaps in an interactive Fit Report, drafts a cover letter only from verified facts, and turns the same job into interview questions with evidence-backed guidance. It never invents experience or predicts hiring outcomes. No account required.
payload.longDescription: 申请前先了解你的 CV 或简历究竟能证明什么。粘贴职位发布信息和简历，或附上一份 PDF/DOCX 简历。ApplyArc 将每项明确要求对应到确切的简历证据，在交互式 Fit Report 中如实展示差距，仅根据已核实事实起草求职信，并将同一职位转化为面试问题，提供有证据支持的指导。它绝不虚构经历或预测招聘结果。无需账户。

payload.name: Alteryx Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to the data your organization has configured in Alteryx One. Explore business questions in plain language, get trusted answers grounded in governed data, and move from "what's happening?" to "what should we look at next?" without switching tools. Use Alteryx One to understand business performance, investigate drivers, prepare updates, and make faster decisions from the data your team already relies on.
payload.longDescription: 将ChatGPT连接到组织在Alteryx One中配置的数据。用日常语言探索业务问题，获取以受治理数据为依据的可信答案，无需切换工具，即可从“正在发生什么？”推进到“接下来应该关注什么？”使用Alteryx One了解业务表现、调查驱动因素、准备情况更新，并利用团队已经依赖的数据更快地作出决策。

payload.name: Open Context
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Open Context lets you store, organize, and reuse context across your AI workflows. You can save profiles, documents, instructions, and other structured information in one place, then load exactly what you need into a conversation or tool when you need it.

Instead of re-explaining background or copying the same prompts, you work from a shared, persistent source of truth. This helps keep conversations consistent, makes personalization easy, and enables workflows that rely on long-lived knowledge and memory.
payload.longDescription:
Open Context 让你在 AI 工作流中存储、整理并重复使用上下文。你可以保存个人资料、文档、说明及其他结构化信息，然后在需要时将恰当的内容载入对话或工具。

无需反复解释背景或复制相同提示词，你可以基于共享且持久的权威信息源开展工作。这有助于保持对话一致、轻松实现个性化，并支持依赖长期知识和记忆的工作流。

payload.name: Listen Later
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Listen Later lets users send user-approved ChatGPT text, URLs, and PDF files to Listen Later so they can be converted into podcast audio and delivered through the user's Listen Later feed.
payload.longDescription: Listen Later 让用户可以将经本人批准的 ChatGPT 文本、URL 和 PDF 文件发送到 Listen Later，转换成播客音频后送达用户的 Listen Later 信息流。

payload.name: ElevenLabs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ElevenLabs helps users create and manage voice agents, review conversations, manage knowledge and tools, and generate speech, images, video and custom voices.
payload.longDescription: ElevenLabs 帮助用户创建和管理语音代理、查看对话、管理知识与工具，并生成语音、图像、视频和自定义声音。

payload.name: Compare Text
payload.description: 比较文本并突出显示更改
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare two versions of text side-by-side and see exactly what changed. This app highlights additions in green, deletions in red, and shows unchanged text clearly. Perfect for reviewing edits, comparing draft versions, tracking document changes, or seeing what modifications were made to your writing. Get instant visual feedback on differences between any two texts with detailed statistics on additions, deletions, and modifications.
payload.longDescription: 并排比较两个版本的文本，准确查看发生了哪些变化。此应用以绿色突出显示新增内容，以红色标出删除内容，并清楚呈现未更改的文本。非常适合审阅编辑、比较草稿版本、跟踪文档变更或查看写作内容的修改情况。对任意两段文本的差异即时提供可视化反馈，并附上新增、删除和修改的详细统计数据。

payload.name: OctoEverywhere
payload.description: 监控和控制 3D 打印机
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OctoEverywhere helps users monitor their connected 3D printers, check live print status and AI failure detection, view webcam snapshots and file listings, debug and fix common 3D printing issues, and use permission-controlled printer commands through ChatGPT.

OctoEverywhere works with any kind of 3D printer, including those made by Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic, QIDI, Snapmaker, Sovol, Flashforge, and more. OctoEverywhere works with OctoPrint, Klipper, Moonraker, Fluidd, Mainsail, PrusaLink, and more.
payload.longDescription:
OctoEverywhere 帮助用户监控已连接的 3D 打印机、查看实时打印状态和 AI 故障检测、查看摄像头快照及文件列表、排查并解决常见 3D 打印问题，以及通过 ChatGPT 使用受权限控制的打印机命令。

OctoEverywhere 适用于各种类型的 3D 打印机，包括 Bambu Lab、Prusa、Creality、Elegoo、Anycubic、QIDI、Snapmaker、Sovol、Flashforge 等品牌的打印机。OctoEverywhere 兼容 OctoPrint、Klipper、Moonraker、Fluidd、Mainsail、PrusaLink 等。

payload.name: Moknah
payload.description: 将文本制作成有声读物
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Moknah turns text and documents into natural-sounding speech and complete audiobooks, with especially strong support for Arabic alongside many other languages. Paste text or upload a PDF, Word, or EPUB, choose a voice, and generate audio you can preview and download. For Arabic, it automatically adds diacritics (tashkeel) and normalizes the text so words are pronounced correctly, with optional emotion and poetry modes. Break longer works into chapters, set a different voice per section, and review quality before you export. A Moknah account is required to generate audio.
payload.longDescription: Moknah 可将文本和文档转换为自然流畅的语音和完整有声读物，尤其擅长阿拉伯语，同时也支持许多其他语言。粘贴文本或上传 PDF、Word 或 EPUB 文件，选择音色，即可生成可预听和下载的音频。对于阿拉伯语，它会自动添加变音符号（tashkeel）并规范化文本，以确保单词发音准确，还提供可选的情感和诗歌模式。长篇作品可以拆分为章节，为不同部分设置不同音色，并在导出前检查质量。生成音频需要 Moknah 账户。

payload.name: TaskNotify
payload.description: 接收真正重要的 Telegram 提醒
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Most recurring tasks notify you every time they run—even when nothing changed. TaskNotify gives ChatGPT a direct line to your private Telegram chat, so it can reach you only when a result, alert, or update is actually worth your attention.

Connect Telegram in one tap, then let ChatGPT deliver important task outcomes beyond the conversation. Messages arrive in real time with rich formatting, while TaskNotify relays message content without storing it.

Use TaskNotify to:
- Receive meaningful results from recurring tasks on Telegram
- Skip empty or no-op notifications that only create noise
- Get urgent alerts and important updates on your phone
- Pair or reconnect a private Telegram chat without copying tokens
- Send readable notifications with bold text, links, code, and quotes
payload.longDescription:
大多数定期任务每次运行都会通知你，即使内容没有变化。TaskNotify 为 ChatGPT 提供直达你私人 Telegram 聊天的通道，只有在结果、提醒或更新确实值得关注时才会联系你。

只需轻点一下即可连接 Telegram，然后让 ChatGPT 在对话之外向你发送重要任务结果。消息会实时送达，并支持丰富格式；TaskNotify 仅转发消息内容，不会存储消息。

使用 TaskNotify 可以：
- 在 Telegram 上接收定期任务的有效结果
- 跳过没有内容或无需操作的通知，避免噪声
- 在手机上接收紧急提醒和重要更新
- 配对或重新连接私人 Telegram 聊天，无需复制令牌
- 发送格式清晰的通知，支持粗体文本、链接、代码和引用

payload.name: InvoiceCraft AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: InvoiceCraft AI helps service businesses create structured invoices from client, service, pricing, deposit, discount, tax, due date, payment method, currency, and template inputs. It returns line items, totals, payment instructions, a late-fee note, and a client-ready invoice message.
payload.longDescription: InvoiceCraft AI 根据客户、服务、价格、定金、折扣、税费、到期日、支付方式、货币和模板输入，帮助服务型企业创建结构化发票。它返回明细项目、合计、付款说明、滞纳金备注和可直接发给客户的发票消息。

payload.name: ButlerBrain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ButlerBrain gives your AI a persistent memory. Save thoughts, search notes, crawl web pages, manage calendar events, and upload documents, all accessible across any AI assistant. Your brain integrates natively with several tools including Obsidian, and every memory is semantically searchable.
payload.longDescription: ButlerBrain 为你的 AI 提供持久记忆。保存想法、搜索笔记、抓取网页、管理日历活动和上传文档，并可在任何 AI 助手中访问。你的大脑可与 Obsidian 等多种工具原生集成，每条记忆都可通过语义搜索查找。

payload.name: Sign.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With the Sign.com ChatGPT app, users can draft agreements, contracts, and other documents, convert them into signing-ready PDFs, and open them directly in Sign.com to sign or send for signature. Users can generate documents from simple prompts or their own HTML, then continue the signing process on Sign.com to collect signatures, manage signers, and finalize documents.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Sign.com ChatGPT 应用，用户可以起草协议、合同和其他文档，将其转换为可签署 PDF，并直接在 Sign.com 中打开以进行签署或发送签署请求。用户既可根据简单提示生成文档，也可用自己的 HTML 生成，然后在 Sign.com 继续签署流程、收集签名、管理签署人并完成文档。

payload.name: Heptabase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Heptabase knowledge base. Search and read cards, journals, PDFs, tags, databases, and whiteboards; view selected cards in an interactive reader; create and edit notes; update properties; and place existing objects on whiteboards.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Heptabase 知识库。搜索并阅读卡片、日志、PDF、标签、数据库和白板；在互动阅读器中查看选定卡片；创建和编辑笔记、更新属性，并将已有对象放置到白板上。

payload.name: Truffle Journal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Harvest the insights from AI chats—save the best parts with your note, recall them instantly later.
payload.longDescription: 从 AI 对话中提取有价值的见解——把重要内容连同笔记一起保存，以后即可快速找回。

payload.name: Outliner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn an idea or an uploaded file into a clean outline right inside ChatGPT.
Ask Outliner to structure a pitch deck, map a product launch, or shape an essay; it instantly builds a logical hierarchy you can promote, trim, or delete — letting you think while it formats.

How to Use Outliner in ChatGPT

1. Connect: Connect the Outliner app to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Activate the app using one of these methods:
Type Commands: Simply type “@” then choose the Outliner app, or type “Outliner” (followed by a space) in the chat box.
Action List: Select it directly from the Action List (Requires the Sider extension).
3. Create: You are ready to go! Try asking specifically:
· “Outline my climate-change research paper.”
· “Break this product concept into a step-by-step workflow.”
· “Summarize this file, then build a project-plan outline.”

When you’re ready, copy the outline and keep refining it with your team.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中直接将一个想法或上传的文件整理成清晰大纲。
让 Outliner 帮你梳理路演演示文稿结构、规划产品发布，或构思文章；它会立即生成逻辑清晰的层级结构，你可以提升层级、精简或删除内容，在整理格式的同时思考。

在 ChatGPT 中如何使用 Outliner

1. 连接：将 Outliner 应用连接到 ChatGPT。
2. 调用：通过以下任一方式启用该应用：
输入命令：输入“@”后选择 Outliner 应用，或者在聊天框中输入“Outliner”（后面加一个空格）。
操作列表：直接从操作列表中选择（需要 Sider 扩展程序）。
3. 创建：现在即可开始！可以尝试提出具体请求：
· “为我的气候变化研究论文列出大纲。”
· “把这个产品概念拆解成逐步工作流。”
· “总结此文件，然后制定项目计划大纲。”

准备好后，复制大纲，并与团队一起继续完善。

payload.name: Smartsheet AU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Make Smartsheet a native part of your AI workflow. Ask your AI to analyze project timelines, create graphs to summarize your sheet information, all through conversation. The Smartsheet connector eliminates manual data entry and repetitive updates, letting you focus on decisions while AI handles the details. Transform how you manage projects with AI that understands your Smartsheet data and can act on it.
payload.longDescription: 让 Smartsheet 成为 AI 工作流中的原生工具。通过对话让 AI 分析项目时间线、创建图表来总结表格信息。Smartsheet 连接器可消除手动数据录入和重复更新，让你专注于决策，由 AI 处理细节。借助能理解并操作 Smartsheet 数据的 AI，改变你的项目管理方式。

payload.name: Owll
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Owll is an AI note-taking product for meetings, recordings, documents, images, and other content. Owll for ChatGPT connects to a user’s authorized Owll library, allowing them to search notes, browse folders, view note details and AI-generated summaries, and access or export transcripts upon request. The current version provides read-only access and cannot create, edit, or delete notes.
payload.longDescription: Owll 是一款适用于会议、录音、文档、图像及其他内容的 AI 笔记产品。Owll for ChatGPT 会连接到用户已授权的 Owll 资料库，让用户搜索笔记、浏览文件夹、查看笔记详情和 AI 生成的摘要，并按需访问或导出文字记录。当前版本仅提供只读访问，无法创建、编辑或删除笔记。

payload.name: Context Link
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your business lives in a thousand places. Give ChatGPT a single way to talk to all of it.

Connect your docs, websites, inboxes, files, and workspaces so ChatGPT can understand what is true right now. Context Link turns scattered business knowledge into source-backed answers, reusable context, and living AI memories your team can keep up to date.

Ask questions, pull source material, observe what has changed, and use ChatGPT with the latest business context instead of re-explaining everything from scratch.
payload.longDescription:
您的业务信息分散在上千处。让 ChatGPT 用一种方式与全部信息对话。

连接文档、网站、收件箱、文件和工作区，让 ChatGPT 理解当前真实情况。Context Link 将分散的业务知识转化为有来源支持的答案、可复用上下文和团队可以持续更新的动态 AI 记忆。

提出问题、提取来源材料、观察变化，并使用最新业务上下文与 ChatGPT 对话，无需每次从头解释。

payload.name: Formbyte
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jump-start form creation inside ChatGPT. Ask Formbyte to whip up surveys, signup forms, polls—then refine or analyze results right in the same thread.

How to Use Formbyte in ChatGPT

1. Connect: Connect the Formbyte app to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type Commands: Simply type “@” then choose the Formbyte app, or type “Formbyte” (followed by a space) in the chat box.
3. Create: You are ready to go! Try asking specifically:
· Formbyte, create a form to collect customer feedback.
· Design a fillable application form for job applicants.
· Formbyte, generate a course-evaluation survey for my online class.

One prompt gives you a polished form plus live Q&A analytics, all in chat. Connect Formbyte and type “create a form” to turn questions into decisions.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中快速开始创建表单。让 Formbyte 快速制作调查问卷、注册表单或投票，然后在同一对话中继续完善或分析结果。

如何在 ChatGPT 中使用 Formbyte

1. 连接：将 Formbyte 应用连接到 ChatGPT。
2. 触发：输入命令，只需输入“@”并从菜单中选择 Formbyte 应用，或者在聊天框中输入“Formbyte”（后接空格）。
3. 创建：准备就绪！可以尝试具体地提出请求：
· Formbyte，创建一份收集客户反馈的表单。
· 设计一份可填写的求职申请表。
· Formbyte，为我的在线课程生成一份课程评价问卷。

只需一个提示，就能在聊天中生成精美表单和实时问答分析。连接 Formbyte 并输入“创建表单”，将问题转化为决策。

payload.name: Rebarly
payload.description: 用 ChatGPT 查询建筑规范
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: We help architects and engineers effectively use AI. We provide access to the IBC and IRC and UFGS code in a simple and effective way. Your ChatGPT can now speak the code saving time and money.
payload.longDescription:
该插件用 ChatGPT 查询建筑规范。以下功能和限制适用：
We help architects and engineers effectively use AI. We provide access to the IBC and IRC and UFGS code in a simple and effective way. Your ChatGPT can now speak the code saving time and money.

payload.name: Plate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Minimal project management for teams and AI agents. Plan work, track tasks, and keep projects moving forward with people and AI agents working side by side. Structure: workspaces, projects, sections, and tasks.
payload.longDescription: 为团队和 AI 代理提供精简的项目管理工具。规划工作、追踪任务，让项目持续推进，使人员与 AI 代理能够并肩协作。结构包括：工作区、项目、分区和任务。

payload.name: Loops
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Loops
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with Loops without leaving ChatGPT. Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access everything else available through the Loops API. Just tell ChatGPT what you want to do.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可使用 Loops。管理联系人和邮件列表、发送事务性邮件、处理事件，并访问 Loops API 提供的其他功能。只需告诉 ChatGPT 你想做什么。

payload.name: Jade Note
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jade Note gives ChatGPT secure access to your personal notes as a persistent memory layer. Through MCP, ChatGPT can search notes by keyword or meaning, read category context, create and append notes, suggest links, and keep knowledge organized. OAuth authentication, per-category access controls, change previews, version history, and rollback make AI-assisted memory safe and transparent while keeping the same Markdown notes editable in the Jade Note web app.
payload.longDescription: Jade Note 为 ChatGPT 安全提供对你个人笔记的访问，作为持久记忆层。通过 MCP，ChatGPT 可以按关键词或含义搜索笔记、读取分类上下文、创建和追加笔记、建议链接并整理知识。OAuth 身份验证、分类级访问控制、变更预览、版本历史和回滚功能，让 AI 辅助记忆安全且透明；同时，同一批 Markdown 笔记仍可在 Jade Note 网页应用中编辑。

payload.name: CloudConvert
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring powerful file conversion and processing into ChatGPT with CloudConvert. Work with documents, images, audio, video, ebooks, archives, and more—without switching between separate tools.

• Convert files between supported formats
• Compress and optimize PDF, PNG, and JPG files
• Merge multiple documents and images into a single PDF
• Create thumbnails from documents, images, videos, and other files
• Add text or image watermarks to PDFs, images, and videos
• Create ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ, and TAR.BZ2 archives
• Capture websites as PDFs, PNGs, or JPGs
• Extract and update file metadata
• Add OCR text layers to scanned PDFs
• Rotate, split, and extract selected PDF pages
• Encrypt, decrypt, and manage PDF permissions
• Convert PDFs to archival PDF/A or print-ready PDF/X standards
• Run custom FFmpeg, ImageMagick, and GraphicsMagick commands
• Build advanced multi-step conversion workflows and monitor their progress

CloudConvert returns processed files as convenient download links and lets users check job status and remaining conversion credits directly in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
通过 CloudConvert 将强大的文件转换和处理功能带入 ChatGPT。处理文档、图片、音频、视频、电子书、压缩包等，无需在不同工具间切换。

• 在支持的格式之间转换文件
• 压缩并优化 PDF、PNG 和 JPG 文件
• 将多个文档和图片合并为一个 PDF
• 从文档、图片、视频及其他文件创建缩略图
• 为 PDF、图片和视频添加文字或图片水印
• 创建 ZIP、RAR、7Z、TAR、TAR.GZ 和 TAR.BZ2 压缩包
• 将网站截取为 PDF、PNG 或 JPG
• 提取并更新文件元数据
• 为扫描版 PDF 添加 OCR 文本层
• 旋转、拆分并提取指定 PDF 页面
• 加密、解密并管理 PDF 权限
• 将 PDF 转换为适用于归档的 PDF/A 或适合印刷的 PDF/X 标准
• 运行自定义 FFmpeg、ImageMagick 和 GraphicsMagick 命令
• 构建高级多步骤转换工作流并监控进度

CloudConvert 会通过便捷的下载链接返回处理后的文件，并允许用户直接在 ChatGPT 中查看任务状态和剩余转换额度。

payload.name: Content Brief Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Content Brief Extractor extracts structured content brief fields from content request text. It returns topic, target audience, channel, deadline, missing fields, and errors. It does not write content, create marketing strategy, choose channels, schedule posts, publish content, or call external systems. The app is stateless, read-only, and only processes the submitted text for the current request.
payload.longDescription: Content Brief Extractor 从内容请求文本中提取结构化内容简报字段。它返回主题、目标受众、渠道、截止日期、缺失字段和错误。它不会撰写内容、制定营销策略、选择渠道、安排帖子、发布内容或调用外部系统。应用无状态、只读，仅处理当前请求中提交的文本。

payload.name: DotSpark
payload.description: 让 AI 像你一样推理
payload.summaryOriginal: Make your AI reason like you
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Everyone now thinks with the same AI, which quietly flattens originality into a confident average. DotSpark is the mirror that keeps your judgment yours. Connect it once and your assistant reads your Thinking Shield at the start of every conversation and follows it for the whole session: challenge before agreeing, make you reason first, keep your ideas and voice yours. As you work, it captures the residue of your thinking — insights ("dots"), connections across them ("sparks"), and a periodic read of how you think — into your personal DotSpark graph. Nothing is sent back to make the AI smarter about you; every signal points at your own self-knowledge.
payload.longDescription: 如今每个人都用相同的 AI 思考，这会悄然让原创性变得扁平，趋向自信却平庸的平均值。DotSpark 是一面镜子，让你的判断始终属于自己。连接一次后，助手会在每次对话开始时读取你的 Thinking Shield，并在整个会话中遵循它：先质疑再赞同，让你先自行推理，并保留你自己的想法和表达方式。在你工作时，它会将思考留下的痕迹——见解（“dots”）、彼此关联（“sparks”），以及定期生成的思维方式解读——保存到你的个人 DotSpark 图谱中。不会发送任何信息来让 AI 更了解你；所有信号都指向你对自己的认识。

payload.name: A-Z Links

payload.name: DocuSeal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DocuSeal lets you create document templates from PDFs, send them for e-signing, and track signing status - all through a simple conversation. Search your templates, send documents to multiple signers, and check who has signed without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: DocuSeal 可让你通过简单对话从 PDF 创建文档模板、发送电子签署请求并跟踪签署状态。搜索模板、向多位签署人发送文档，并在不离开聊天的情况下查看谁已签署。

payload.name: Zeiko Agents
payload.description: 创建并测试客服智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create a private customer-support agent from your website, test its answers before launch, and request approval to activate it. Review support quality and evidence-backed improvement suggestions in your Zeiko workspace.
payload.longDescription: 根据你的网站创建私有客服智能体，在上线前测试其回答，并申请批准后再启用。在 Zeiko 工作区中查看客服质量以及有证据支持的改进建议。

payload.name: Plane
payload.description: 借助 Plane 推进工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plane brings the user's Plane workspace into ChatGPT. Users can browse projects and work items, create and update tasks and epics, filter and count work with Plane Query Language, plan cycles, modules, and milestones, triage the intake queue, manage releases and their changelogs, maintain pages and collections, track customers and their requests, log time, and adjust labels, states, estimates, and custom properties — all through the authenticated Plane API for their own workspace.
payload.longDescription: Plane 将用户的 Plane 工作区引入 ChatGPT。用户可以浏览项目和工作项，创建并更新任务与大型任务，使用 Plane Query Language 筛选和统计工作，规划周期、模块和里程碑，整理收件队列，管理版本发布及其变更日志，维护页面与集合，追踪客户及其请求，记录工时，并调整标签、状态、预估值和自定义属性——所有操作均通过已认证的 Plane API 在用户自己的工作区中完成。

payload.name: AI Delivery Evidence Checker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check whether AI coding completion claims are supported by the delivery materials and test evidence you provide. Extract verifiable criteria, identify supported and unsupported work, find evidence gaps, and generate a structured delivery verdict—all without accessing repositories or modifying code.
payload.longDescription: 检查AI编码任务的完成声明是否得到你提供的交付材料和测试证据支持。提取可验证的标准，识别有证据支持和缺乏支持的工作，找出证据缺口，并生成结构化的交付结论，全程无需访问代码仓库或修改代码。

payload.name: MusicBook Pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MusicBook Pro is a private productivity workspace for musicians. It searches user-approved songwriting-library text and music metadata on a connected Mac, inspects Songs, Drafts, Ideas, Projects and Setlists, and creates new Ideas or Setlists without changing existing work.
payload.longDescription: MusicBook Pro 是面向音乐人的私人效率工作区。它可以搜索已连接 Mac 上经用户批准的歌曲库文本和音乐元数据，查看歌曲、草稿、灵感、项目和歌单，并创建新的灵感或歌单，而不会更改现有内容。

payload.name: MarcoPolo
payload.description: 安全的 AI 数据工作区
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MarcoPolo spins up a secure container where ChatGPT can work with your actual data. Connect to your databases, APIs, S3, lakehouses, CRMs, Jira, logs and much more—using scoped credentials that are never exposed to the model.

ChatGPT gets DuckDB, Python, a shell, and a set of tools to explore, query, transform, and analyze data across systems. The workspace persists over time, so that you can build on your work.

Prep a report, understand your data, debug an issue, or review the latest metrics right here in the conversation.
payload.longDescription:
MarcoPolo 会启动一个安全容器，让 ChatGPT 能够处理你的实际数据。连接数据库、API、S3、数据湖仓、CRM、Jira、日志等系统——使用范围受限的凭据，模型永远看不到这些凭据。

ChatGPT 可使用 DuckDB、Python、shell 以及一组工具，跨系统浏览、查询、转换和分析数据。工作区会长期保留，让你可以在已有工作的基础上继续推进。

你可以直接在对话中准备报告、了解数据、调试问题或查看最新指标。

payload.name: VaultSage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VaultSage helps users upload text files as persistent AI memory, browse and search stored knowledge, chat with VaultSage AI using file context, inspect storage metrics, organize files into directories, create share links, and remove outdated files.
payload.longDescription: VaultSage 帮助用户上传文本文件作为持久化 AI 记忆，浏览和搜索已存储的知识，结合文件上下文与 VaultSage AI 聊天，查看存储指标，将文件整理到目录中，创建分享链接，并移除过时文件。

payload.name: 6sense
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AI assistant to 6sense to retrieve account insights using natural language. Access account data, 6QA trends, keyword activity, and campaign performance directly in your workflow.
payload.longDescription: 将你的AI助手连接到6sense，使用自然语言获取客户账户洞察。直接在工作流程中访问账户数据、6QA趋势、关键词活动和广告系列表现。

payload.name: Nuwa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Nuwa Pen to ChatGPT. Search, recall, and summarize your handwritten notes using natural language. Ask what you wrote today, find notes about a specific topic, browse your notebooks, or view a rendered image of your handwriting — all without leaving the conversation. Nuwa turns your pen-and-paper notes into part of your AI workflow.
payload.longDescription: 将 Nuwa Pen 连接到 ChatGPT。使用自然语言搜索、回忆和总结手写笔记。询问今天写了什么、查找特定主题的笔记、浏览笔记本，或查看手写内容的渲染图像——全程无需离开对话。Nuwa 将纸笔笔记融入你的 AI 工作流程。

payload.name: WeTransfer
payload.description: 通过 WeTransfer 发送文件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.

Connect your WeTransfer account and share any file from your chat — documents, images, exports, generated assets — without leaving the conversation. Just ask, and the connector uploads the files to WeTransfer and returns a clean, shareable download link. Prefer to send it directly? Add recipients and WeTransfer will email the transfer for you, sent from your own account.

What you can do
- Share one or many files at once and get a ready-to-share download link
- Email a transfer to one or more recipients, with an optional title and message
- Send large files without bloating the conversation

How it works
Every transfer is created in your own WeTransfer account, so it appears in your transfer history and follows your plan's limits and expiry. You sign in securely with your WeTransfer account — the assistant only ever gets permission to send files on your behalf, and never sees your WeTransfer password. You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.
payload.longDescription:
直接通过 WeTransfer 从对话中发送文件。

连接 WeTransfer 账户后，无需离开对话即可分享聊天中的任意文件——文档、图像、导出文件或生成的素材。只需提出请求，连接器就会将文件上传到 WeTransfer，并返回整洁、可分享的下载链接。如果想直接发送，请添加收件人；WeTransfer 会从你的账户发送邮件，递送该文件。

你可以做什么
- 一次分享一个或多个文件，并获取可直接分享的下载链接
- 将文件传送邮件发送给一个或多个收件人，并可添加标题和消息
- 发送大文件，而不会让对话变得臃肿

工作方式
每次传送都会在你自己的 WeTransfer 账户中创建，因此会显示在传送历史记录中，并遵循你套餐的限制和有效期。你使用 WeTransfer 账户安全登录——助手只会获得代表你发送文件的权限，绝不会看到你的 WeTransfer 密码。你可以随时断开连接以撤销访问权限。

payload.name: Dijin Memory
payload.description: 在各 AI 间回忆记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dijin is the **Memory Layer** for your digital life and AI agents — an open, owner-signed, cite-or-refuse store of your decisions, action items, entities, and evidence citations.

Connect this MCP server to ChatGPT and ask it to recall what you've decided on a project, who moved a discussion forward, what your last release shipped, or any other signal Dijin has already captured (from GitHub, Slack, Teams, your own typed Add Memory entries, and more). ChatGPT calls `search` to discover records, then `fetch` for the signed `EvidencePack` — every answer comes back as Ed25519-signed proof with sources and a `/api/verify` link. Never a guess.

Dijin is read-only on the OpenAI side. The MCP server does not expose `memory.write` to ChatGPT; all writes happen on Dijin's own surfaces, behind the user's own login.
payload.longDescription:
Dijin 是你数字生活和 AI 代理的**记忆层**——一个开放、由所有者签名、可引用或拒绝作答的存储库，用来保存你的决定、行动事项、实体和证据引用。

将此 MCP 服务器连接到 ChatGPT，然后询问它你在某个项目中做过什么决定、是谁推动了讨论、上次发布包含什么，或 Dijin 已经捕获的其他信息（来自 GitHub、Slack、Teams、你手动添加的 Add Memory 条目等）。ChatGPT 会调用 `search` 发现记录，再调用 `fetch` 获取签名的 `EvidencePack`——每个答案都会附带 Ed25519 签名证明、来源以及 `/api/verify` 链接。绝不凭空猜测。

在 OpenAI 一侧，Dijin 为只读。MCP 服务器不会向 ChatGPT 暴露 `memory.write`；所有写入都在 Dijin 自有界面中、经用户本人登录后完成。

payload.name: BrightHire

payload.name: ChatData Sync

One connection can manage multiple trackers for workflows like client invoices, garden logs, workouts, and maintenance records.
payload.longDescription: ChatData Sync 将 ChatGPT 变成你的个人追踪助手。用日常英语描述你想追踪的内容，它便会创建一个私密的结构化追踪器，你可以直接在聊天中填写、搜索和更新。一次连接即可管理多个追踪器，用于客户发票、花园日志、锻炼和维护记录等工作流程。

payload.name: IMEI Checker by Kelpom

payload.longDescription: Kelpom 根据 15 位数字的 IMEI 识别关联的手机或平板型号。它使用内部 TAC 缓存，并在需要时通过供应商查询，返回设备商品名、品牌或制造商以及型号。

payload.name: Aide Calendar: AI Planner
payload.description: 将截图和语音转为日程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Aide Calendar is a calendar & task app for iPhone and iPad — now in ChatGPT.

Capture a plan in chat — type it, paste it, or show ChatGPT a screenshot — and it saves straight to Aide Calendar on your iPhone / iPad: event or task created, reminders set, synced across your devices. No retyping.

In ChatGPT
• Type or paste — "lunch Friday 1 pm at Nobu," "submit the report by Friday 5 pm"
• Upload a screenshot — a text, an email, an invite; ChatGPT reads it and saves it
• Saved complete — date, time, venue, attendees, phone, notes, and alerts
• Recurring and all-day events, and no duplicates when you re-save

On your iPhone & iPad — Aide Calendar
Everything you save here lives in the full Aide Calendar app, where you run your day:
• Capture on your phone too — screenshots, photos, voice notes, anything shared, in any language
• Five views (Day · 3-Day · Week · Week-list · Month), drag to reschedule, instant search
• A real task manager — priorities, due dates, Overdue / by day / Completed
• Tap a number to call, message, or WhatsApp; tap an address to open in Maps
• Real-time sync across iPhone and iPad

Private by design
• Saves only what you ask · never reads your other chats
• Keeps no copy of your events — they live only in your Aide account
• No ads, no tracking — Aide never uses your events to train AI models

Requires the Aide Calendar app for iPhone & iPad (iOS 17+)
payload.longDescription:
Aide Calendar是一款适用于iPhone和iPad的日历与任务应用，如今也已登陆ChatGPT。

在聊天中记录计划：输入、粘贴，或向ChatGPT展示截图，内容就会直接保存到你iPhone / iPad上的Aide Calendar：创建日程或任务、设置提醒，并在设备间同步。无需重新输入。

在ChatGPT中
• 输入或粘贴：“周五下午1点在Nobu吃午餐”“周五下午5点前提交报告”
• 上传截图：短信、邮件、邀请；ChatGPT会读取并保存
• 完整保存：日期、时间、地点、参与者、电话、备注和提醒
• 支持重复和全天日程，重新保存时不会产生重复项

在你的iPhone和iPad上——Aide Calendar
你在这里保存的一切都保存在完整的Aide Calendar应用中，你可以在那里安排每一天：
• 也可在手机上记录：截图、照片、语音笔记、任何分享内容，支持任何语言
• 五种视图（日 · 3日 · 周 · 周列表 · 月）、拖动调整日程、即时搜索
• 完整的任务管理：优先级、截止日期、已逾期 / 按天 / 已完成
• 点按号码即可拨打电话、发短信或使用WhatsApp；点按地址即可在Maps中打开
• 在iPhone和iPad之间实时同步

注重隐私的设计
• 只保存你要求保存的内容 · 绝不读取你的其他聊天
• 不保留日程副本——日程只存于你的Aide账户中
• 无广告、无追踪——Aide绝不使用你的日程训练AI模型

需要安装适用于iPhone和iPad的Aide Calendar应用（iOS 17+）

payload.name: Schwab Jobs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find a career built on trust, growth, and real impact.

Whether you’re ready for your next role or just exploring what’s possible, this plug inputs Schwab opportunities at your fingertips so you can spend less time searching and more time finding the role that’s right for you.

payload.name: Project Kickoff Pack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn supplied project material and confirmed items into a structured kickoff pack. Extract project goals, roles, responsibilities, milestones, risks, and kickoff conditions. Proposed items are clearly separated and excluded from the current deliverable.
payload.longDescription: 将提供的项目材料和已确认事项整理为结构化的启动资料包。提取项目目标、角色、职责、里程碑、风险和启动条件。建议事项会清晰区分，并排除在当前交付内容之外。

payload.name: Operator Powers
payload.description: 助力运营与增长的 AI 技能
payload.summaryOriginal: AI skills to operate and grow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Operator Powers is a collection of practical AI skills for non-technical operators wanting to power up in their work.  Use these skills to improve how work gets done, understand what customers really want, create content and designs, pressure test decisions, strengthen offers and sales pages, and launch digital products. Every skill handles a specific task and finished deliverable.
payload.longDescription: Operator Powers 汇集了实用 AI 技能，面向希望提升工作效率的非技术运营人员。使用这些技能改进工作方式、了解客户真实需求、创建内容和设计、检验决策、强化产品方案和销售页面，以及推出数字产品。每项技能都针对特定任务，并能产出完整交付物。

payload.name: Docs AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Write a clear, engaging description that highlights what your plugin does and why people will love it. Focus on concrete user value and avoid exaggerative, misleading claims. This will appear publicly on your plugin’s directory page.
Connect ChatGPT directly to your Docs, so drafting and revising documents happens in the same place as the rest of your work: no copying text back and forth between a chat window and a browser tab.

Ask for a document by name and it searches your Drive to find it, then reads the contents back as clean markdown you can quote, summarize, translate or rework. Ask for something new and it creates the document and writes the first draft. From there you get real editing, not just appending: insert and replace text anywhere in the document, replace every occurrence of a phrase in one pass, restyle paragraphs and individual runs of text, and turn lists into proper bullets or strip them back out.

Tables are fully supported: create them, add or remove rows and columns, merge cells, style rows and cells, and pin header rows so they repeat across pages. So is the document furniture most tools skip: headers, footers, footnotes, page and section breaks, page layout settings, inline images, dates and people chips.

Every edit starts by inspecting the document's actual structure, so changes land in the right place instead of clobbering the surrounding text, and related changes are applied together as a single batch rather than one risky rewrite. Word files in your Drive work too: .docx is converted so it can be read and
edited like anything else.

It fits naturally into recurring document work: updating status reports, filling out templates, cleaning up formatting across a long file, and reworking a draft someone else started.
payload.longDescription:
撰写清晰、有吸引力的介绍，突出插件的功能以及用户喜爱它的原因。侧重具体的用户价值，避免夸大或误导性宣传。此介绍将公开显示在插件目录页面上。将 ChatGPT 直接连接到你的 Docs，让起草和修订文档与其他工作在同一处完成：无需在聊天窗口和浏览器标签页之间来回复制文本。

按名称请求文档，它会在 Drive 中搜索并找到文档，然后以整洁的 Markdown 格式读取内容，供你引用、摘要、翻译或改写。需要新文档时，它会创建文档并写入初稿。之后你可以真正编辑，而不只是追加内容：在文档任意位置插入和替换文字，一次性替换短语的所有出现处，重新设置段落和单个文本片段的样式，以及将列表转换为规范项目符号列表或移除项目符号。

全面支持表格：创建表格、增删行列、合并单元格、设置行和单元格样式，以及固定表头行以便跨页重复。也支持许多工具忽略的文档元素：页眉、页脚、脚注、分页符和分节符、页面布局设置、行内图片、日期和人员信息卡片。

每次编辑前都会检查文档的实际结构，确保更改落在正确位置，不会覆盖周围文本；相关更改会作为单个批次一起应用，而不是进行一次风险较高的整体重写。Drive 中的 Word 文件也可使用：系统会转换 `.docx` 文件，以便像其他文档一样读取和编辑。

它适合周期性文档工作，例如更新状态报告、填写模板、统一长文档的格式，以及修改他人起草的文稿。

payload.name: STORM Brains4Ai
payload.description: 安全地自动化 AI 工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: STORM Brains4Ai helps teams run AI-powered workflows with governed tools for knowledge search, content generation, provider simulation, product catalog lookup, checkout session creation, and GeoQode execution.
payload.longDescription: STORM Brains4Ai 帮助团队使用受治理的工具运行 AI 工作流，包括知识搜索、内容生成、服务提供方模拟、产品目录查询、结账会话创建和 GeoQode 执行。

payload.name: FlagStat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlagStat helps flag football programs get clear answers about scoring, stats, reports, rulesets, and season operations. Coaches, athletic directors, league organizers, and scorekeepers can use it to understand live scoring, film review workflows, exports, compliance needs, and program setup inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: FlagStat 帮助腰旗橄榄球项目清楚了解得分、统计数据、报告、规则体系和赛季运营。教练、体育主管、联赛组织者和记分员可以在 ChatGPT 中了解实时记分、录像复盘流程、数据导出、合规需求和项目设置。

payload.name: GTD Brain: Getting Things Done
payload.description: 在聊天中管理 GTD 看板
payload.summaryOriginal: Manage your GTD board in chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GTD Brain brings your Getting Things Done board into ChatGPT. Ask what's on your plate and it shows the exact slice you asked about — your inbox, your next actions, your projects, or who you're waiting on — rendered inline as part of the answer. Capture new items to your inbox in one line, move cards between columns, and mark things done, all from chat. Your board stays in sync with the GTD Brain web, Android, and iOS apps. Requires a GTD Brain account.
payload.longDescription: GTD Brain 将你的 Getting Things Done（GTD）看板带入 ChatGPT。询问当前待办事项，即可内嵌查看你指定的内容：收件箱、下一步行动、项目，或等待回复的人。可通过聊天用一句话记录新事项、在列之间移动卡片并标记完成。看板会与 GTD Brain 网页版、Android 和 iOS 应用保持同步。需要 GTD Brain 账号。

payload.name: Vasara
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vasara connects ChatGPT to Lithuania's primary legal sources: national legislation, EU regulations and directives, and case law from the Constitutional Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court, the Court of Justice of the EU, and the European Court of Human Rights.

Use it to look up a specific court decision by case number, search case law and legislation by topic, pull relevant passages from long legal documents, or find guidance from state authorities and municipalities — with sources ChatGPT can cite directly in its answers.

Plugin searches and retrieves legal sources, doesn't create, edit, or submit anything. Requires a Vasara account.
payload.longDescription:
Vasara 将 ChatGPT 连接到立陶宛的主要法律来源：国家立法、欧盟法规和指令，以及宪法法院、最高法院、最高行政法院、欧盟法院和欧洲人权法院的判例法。

可用它按案号查找具体法院裁决、按主题搜索判例法和立法、从篇幅较长的法律文件中提取相关段落，或查找国家机关和市政部门的指导信息；ChatGPT 可以在回答中直接引用这些来源。

此插件仅搜索和检索法律来源，不会创建、编辑或提交任何内容。需要 Vasara 账户。

payload.name: Octopus.do
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Octopus.do builds sitemaps: a tree of pages, each page a stack of blocks, each block a wireframe. This connects that to ChatGPT app. Read an existing project — its pages, blocks, and structure — or turn a description or a sketch into a full sitemap: create pages, add blocks with wireframes, move and restructure the tree, all in one batch. Runs through your own octopus.do account over OAuth; the assistant only ever sees projects you already have access to.
payload.longDescription: Octopus.do 用于构建站点地图：由页面组成的树状结构，每个页面包含一组模块，每个模块对应一个线框图。该应用现已连接到 ChatGPT。你可以读取现有项目的页面、模块和结构，也可以根据描述或草图生成完整站点地图：批量创建页面、添加包含线框图的模块、移动并重组树状结构。通过 OAuth 使用你自己的 octopus.do 账户；助手只能看到你已有权限访问的项目。

payload.name: Matchbox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Matchbox helps you find the right product or tool for a real problem. Describe what you're struggling with in plain language — "I keep forgetting to take my medication," "I need to track expenses across three currencies" — and Matchbox returns specific products matched to your situation, ranked by how well they fit rather than how popular they are. It surfaces lesser-known and newer tools alongside established ones, so you discover options that generic searches and listicles miss.
payload.longDescription: Matchbox 帮助你针对实际问题找到合适的产品或工具。用日常语言描述困扰你的事情——“我总忘记吃药”“我需要用三种货币追踪支出”——Matchbox 就会推荐与你情况相符的具体产品，并按匹配程度排序，而不是按热门程度排序。它会同时展示鲜为人知和较新的工具以及成熟产品，帮你发现通用搜索和榜单文章容易遗漏的选择。

payload.name: mytesla.io
payload.description: 用 AI 控制你的 Tesla
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your Tesla app already sends commands. This plugin is what it can't do. mytesla.io plugs your car into everything your AI already knows — your calendar, the weather, your routines — and decides when to act. Ask for an outcome, not a button: "have the cabin cool by the time my last meeting ends," "be charged to 100% by 7 AM, off-peak only," "if frost is forecast tonight, defrost before my first meeting." Set it once and it runs on its own. Or just ask — "where's my car, is it locked, did I leave the windows open in the rain?" — and get one answer pulled from live data across systems, instead of tapping through a dashboard. Climate, charging, security, and status: 40 actions through Tesla's official Fleet API. No driving control, your car tokens stay server-side, revocable anytime. Not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.
payload.longDescription: 你的 Tesla 应用已经可以发送指令，而这个插件能做它做不到的事。mytesla.io 将汽车连接到 AI 已知的信息——你的日历、天气和日常安排——并判断何时采取行动。提出你想要的结果，而不是点选按钮：“在我最后一场会议结束时让车厢凉爽”“只在非高峰时段充电，并在早上 7 AM 前充到 100%”“如果今晚预报有霜，就在我第一场会议前除霜”。设置一次后，它便会自动运行。你也可以直接询问：“我的车在哪儿？锁好了吗？下雨时我是不是忘了关车窗？”系统会整合多个系统的实时数据一次作答，无需你在仪表板中逐项查找。通过 Tesla 官方 Fleet API 执行气候、充电、安全和状态方面的 40 项操作。不控制驾驶；车辆令牌保留在服务器端，且可随时撤销。与 Tesla, Inc. 无关联。

payload.name: Guides
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Guides is a collaborative editor for living personal notebooks in ChatGPT. Read structure, scaffold outlines, fill and revise pages over time—preference profiles, meal plans, learning journeys. OAuth to the user's account; the guide is the primary artifact, not chat history.
payload.longDescription: Guides 是 ChatGPT 中用于持续维护个人笔记本的协作编辑器。阅读结构、搭建提纲，并随时间填写和修订页面，例如偏好档案、膳食计划和学习旅程。通过 OAuth 连接用户账号；指南本身是主要内容，而非聊天记录。

payload.name: Tallyfy Workflow Automation
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Tallyfy and run your workflows right from chat. Launch and track processes, complete and assign tasks, manage approvals, search across your organization, and build or update templates, all in your own Tallyfy account.

Try asking:
"Launch the New Employee Onboarding process for Jane Doe"
"Show me my open tasks" or "what is Sarah working on?"
"What templates do we have?"
"Create an approval workflow for vendor onboarding"
"Complete the 'Send welcome email' task"

Built by Tallyfy, the workflow and process automation platform for teams. You sign in with your own Tallyfy account, and the assistant only ever sees what you can see. 100+ actions across tasks, processes, templates, approvals, forms, and search.
payload.longDescription:
连接 Tallyfy，直接在聊天中运行工作流。启动和追踪流程、完成和分配任务、管理审批、搜索整个组织，并在自己的 Tallyfy 账户中创建或更新模板。

可以试着这样问：
“为 Jane Doe 启动新员工入职流程。”
“显示我的未完成任务”或“Sarah 正在处理什么？”
“我们有哪些模板？”
“创建供应商入职审批工作流。”
“完成‘发送欢迎邮件’任务。”

由团队工作流与流程自动化平台 Tallyfy 打造。使用自己的 Tallyfy 账户登录，助手只能查看你有权查看的内容。支持 100+ 项操作，涵盖任务、流程、模板、审批、表单和搜索。

payload.name: Floaro
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中管理 eBay 业务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Floaro account to access marketplace information directly in ChatGPT. View connected marketplace accounts, product totals, sales performance, products sold during selected periods, and listings without templates.

Floaro uses secure OAuth authentication and only returns data available to your authorized company and marketplace accounts. The integration is read-only and cannot create, edit, publish, purchase, or delete anything.
payload.longDescription:
连接 Floaro 账户后可查看已连接市场账户、产品总数、销售表现、指定期间售出商品和无模板列表。使用安全

OAuth，只返回授权公司和市场账户可见数据；只读，不能创建、编辑、发布、购买或删除。

payload.name: IQLand
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IQLand turns a U.S. street address into a developer-grade property report. Resolve a parcel, read its zoning and buildable envelope, estimate construction cost, run SmartBuild feasibility against a library of architectural plans, pull comparable sales, and generate a full Appraisal IQ (cost approach + adjusted comps + reconciled value). Built for investors, developers, agents, and appraisers evaluating U.S. real estate. All tools are read-only: they look up and derive data from IQLand's zoning, cost, and architectural-plans services and public parcel/listing data, and never create, modify, or delete records.
payload.longDescription: IQLand 将美国街道地址转换为面向开发者的房产报告：解析地块，读取分区和可建范围，估算建造成本，基于建筑方案库运行 SmartBuild 可行性分析，提取可比成交并生成完整 Appraisal IQ（成本法、调整后可比法和协调价值）。面向评估美国房地产的投资者、开发商、经纪人和评估师。所有工具只读，仅从 IQLand 的分区、成本和建筑方案服务以及公共地块/挂牌数据查询和推导，不创建、修改或删除记录。

payload.name: Workjournal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Workjournal is a structured work journal built for multi-agent and multi-teammate collaboration. Log decisions, session rationale, and project notes directly from ChatGPT or any AI agent. Every entry is instantly searchable and shareable across your team. Use Workjournal to surface the context behind past decisions, hand off work between agents, and keep a living record of why your project evolved the way it did.
payload.longDescription: Workjournal 是一款结构化工作日志，专为多智能体和多成员协作而设计。你可以直接通过 ChatGPT 或任何 AI 智能体记录决策、会话依据和项目笔记。每条记录都能立即搜索并与团队共享。使用 Workjournal 找回以往决策背景、在智能体间交接工作，并持续记录项目演变的原因。

payload.name: Qu Review
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get an independent second opinion on any ChatGPT response, right in the conversation. Qu Review uses a panel of independent AI reviewers to critically examine what ChatGPT told you from multiple angles, then combines their findings into one clear, actionable report.

Each review tells you what's accurate, what might be wrong, what's missing, and what's worth exploring further, along with an easy-to-read scorecard so you can see at a glance how much to trust the answer.

Great for anything where getting it right matters: health questions, financial decisions, school work, professional research, or any time something just doesn't sound right.
payload.longDescription:
在对话中即可为任意 ChatGPT 回复征求独立的第二意见。Qu Review 会召集一组独立 AI 审阅者，从多个角度批判性地检查 ChatGPT 的回答，然后将他们的发现汇总成一份清晰且可执行的报告。

每份审阅都会说明哪些内容准确、哪些可能有误、遗漏了什么，以及哪些方面值得进一步探索；还会提供易读的评分卡，让你一眼看出答案有多可信。

适用于任何准确性至关重要的场景：健康问题、财务决策、学业任务、专业研究，或任何听起来不太对劲的内容。

payload.name: FlowSavvy
payload.description: AI 日程与任务规划器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlowSavvy turns your tasks into a realistic schedule automatically. Use ChatGPT to create, update, complete, and organize tasks, manage calendar events, view your schedule, prioritize work, and plan your day using natural language. FlowSavvy automatically schedules tasks around your existing commitments, adapts when plans change, and helps you stay on top of your deadlines without the hassle of manually rearranging your calendar.
payload.longDescription: FlowSavvy 会自动将任务安排成现实可行的日程。使用 ChatGPT 创建、更新、完成和整理任务，管理日历活动、查看日程、安排工作优先级，并通过自然语言规划一天。FlowSavvy 会根据你已有的安排自动排定任务；计划改变时，它也会及时调整，帮助你轻松跟进截止日期，无需手动反复调整日历。

payload.name: Spoki
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Spoki connects ChatGPT to the Spoki staging account so users can inspect contacts, campaigns, tickets, lists, templates, automations, and CRM records, then perform supported Spoki workflow updates through the MCP tools.
payload.longDescription: Spoki 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Spoki 暂存账户，让用户可以检查联系人、营销活动、工单、列表、模板、自动化流程和 CRM 记录，然后通过 MCP 工具执行 Spoki 支持的工作流更新。

payload.name: Sitemate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Sitemate app in ChatGPT lets you search, query, and interact with your construction and project management data in one place. Access information stored across Sitemate, including Dashpivot, using natural language to surface insights, track progress, and answer questions instantly.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT 中的 Sitemate 应用让你能在一处搜索、查询并使用施工和项目管理数据。你可以用自然语言访问 Sitemate（包括 Dashpivot）中存储的信息，提取洞察、跟踪进度并即时解答问题。

payload.name: Lyssna
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lyssna's MCP server connects your research data to ChatGPT, so you can ask about your studies and get answers pulled from your actual data instead of a guess.

Search across every usability test and survey you have access to. Pull test details, study structure, screener answers, responses, recordings, and interview transcripts. Compare results across studies instead of reopening each one, and bring findings into whatever you're working on next.

This is a read-only connector: it retrieves your Lyssna research data but never creates or modifies anything. Access follows your existing Lyssna permissions, so you'll only see what you already have access to.
payload.longDescription:
Lyssna 的 MCP 服务器将你的研究数据连接到 ChatGPT，让你可以针对实际数据提问并获得回答，而不是依赖猜测。

搜索你有权访问的所有可用性测试和问卷。获取测试详情、研究结构、筛选题答案、回复、录音和访谈记录。跨研究比较结果，无需逐个重新打开；并将发现带入接下来正在处理的工作中。

这是只读连接器：它只会检索你的 Lyssna 研究数据，不会创建或修改任何内容。访问权限沿用你现有的 Lyssna 权限，因此你只能看到自己已有权访问的内容。

payload.name: ScalperIntel AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ScalperIntel AI answers questions about ScalperIntel's indicators and lets verified customers manage their own licenses without leaving the chat.

Connecting takes one step: enter an email and the 6-digit code sent to it. With any email it answers from ScalperIntel's official product knowledge base — what an indicator detects and plots, what each setting does when you change it, installation and setup on NinjaTrader 8, chart and bar-type compatibility, pricing and license types, and which indicator suits a given style of trading. Answers are grounded in that knowledge base and cited rather than improvised.

Sign in with the email used to purchase and it also acts on that account: list licenses and their status, diagnose a license problem against the real license state rather than a guess, submit a new machine ID, switch between Named User and Machine ID activation, and log an issue for the support team with a reference number.

Scope is enforced in code, not by instruction. It gives no trading advice and makes no performance or profit claims; it answers about the software only. The signed-in email is read from the verified session and never from text typed into a prompt, so the license tools can only ever act on the account that signed in.
payload.longDescription:
ScalperIntel AI 可回答有关 ScalperIntel 指标的问题，并让已验证客户直接在聊天中管理自己的许可证。

连接只需一步：输入电子邮件地址和发送到该地址的 6 位验证码。使用任意电子邮件地址都可以从 ScalperIntel 官方产品知识库获取解答，包括指标检测和绘制的内容、各项设置变更后的作用、NinjaTrader 8 的安装与设置、图表和柱形类型兼容性、价格与许可证类型，以及适合特定交易风格的指标。答案均以该知识库为依据并附有引用，而非凭空编造。

使用购买时的电子邮件地址登录后，还可以对该账户执行操作：列出许可证及其状态、根据实际许可证状态而非猜测诊断许可证问题、提交新的机器 ID、在 Named User 和 Machine ID 激活方式之间切换，并为支持团队登记问题以获取参考编号。

权限范围由代码强制执行，而非依赖指令。它不提供交易建议，也不对表现或利润作出任何声称；只回答有关软件的问题。登录邮箱从已验证会话中读取，绝不会从提示中输入的文本读取，因此许可证工具只能操作当前登录的账户。

payload.name: Sally AI
payload.description: 查找会议中的任何内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sally records, transcribes and summarizes meetings. This app lets ChatGPT search those meetings, read summaries and transcripts, manage the tasks that came out of them, and send the Sally assistant into an upcoming online meeting.
payload.longDescription: Sally 可录制、转录并总结会议。此应用让 ChatGPT 搜索这些会议、阅读摘要和转录内容、管理会议产生的任务，并将 Sally 助手加入即将举行的线上会议。

payload.name: Hemelion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hemelion Decision Tools brings two reflection paths to ChatGPT: Clarity for structuring difficult, non-regulated decisions and MindScan for examining recurring response patterns without diagnosis or fixed personality labels. It can choose the appropriate path, assess decision readiness from four explicit ratings, and explain Hemelion’s public method, safeguards, and evidence boundaries. The tools are free, require no account, and do not access private scans or reports.
payload.longDescription: Hemelion Decision Tools 为 ChatGPT 提供两种反思路径：Clarity 用于梳理复杂且不受监管的决策；MindScan 用于观察反复出现的应对模式，不提供诊断，也不贴固定人格标签。它可以选择适当路径，根据四项明确评分评估决策准备度，并解释 Hemelion 的公开方法、安全措施和证据边界。工具免费、无需账号，也不会访问私人扫描结果或报告。

payload.name: PeopleRun AI v.2
payload.description: 构建清晰的 AI 工作任务包
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PeopleRun AI helps users turn an idea into a clear work packet with a goal, sources, proof, and next action. It is designed for reviewing product work, keeping build context organized, and preparing handoffs for ChatGPT or other AI tools.
payload.longDescription: PeopleRun AI 帮助用户将想法整理成清晰的工作任务包，其中包含目标、来源、依据和下一步行动。它适用于审查产品工作、整理构建上下文，以及为 ChatGPT 或其他 AI 工具准备交接材料。

payload.name: Simplified
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Simplified brings your marketing workspace into ChatGPT. Generate AI images and video, create speech from text, draft and publish social posts across 13 connected channels, manage brand kits, projects and tasks, plan content calendars and campaigns, and analyze social performance — all without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: Simplified 将你的营销工作区带入 ChatGPT。生成 AI 图像和视频、将文本转为语音、起草并发布到 13 个已连接渠道的社交帖子、管理品牌套件、项目和任务、规划内容日历和营销活动，并分析社交表现——这一切都无需离开对话。

payload.name: Octopad
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Octopad is the AI brain for builders: the workspace where AIs organize work and knowledge following a shared method.

ChatGPT turns your discussions into structured plans with detailed tasks that persist across sessions, so your projects move forward instead of restarting.

As you work, it saves the knowledge behind your project, from product spec to business model or competitor analysis, along with key information like decisions and their reasons.

Before a task, ChatGPT asks for a briefing built for that exact task, so it starts informed instead of from a blank page.

Every AI you connect works the same way, from the same record, in one workspace.
payload.longDescription:
Octopad 是构建者的 AI 大脑：一个让 AI 按共同方法组织工作和知识的工作区。

ChatGPT 会把讨论转成包含详细任务的结构化计划，并跨会话持续保存，让项目不断推进而无需重新开始。

工作期间，它会保存项目背后的知识，从产品规格到商业模式或竞争分析，并记录决策及其原因等关键信息。
执行任务前，ChatGPT

会询问为该任务量身定制的简报，让它从充分背景开始，而不是从空白页面开始。
你连接的每个

AI 都在同一工作区中使用同一记录，以相同方式工作。

payload.name: Airepoto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.
payload.longDescription:
Airepoto将ChatGPT连接到你的会议录音、转写稿和AI摘要。

使用自然语言跨工作空间和群组查找会议、阅读标注说话人的转写稿，并获取包含行动事项的AI摘要，全程无需离开对话。

你可以做什么
- 按工作空间、群组和关键词搜索并列出会议
- 阅读带有说话人标注的完整转写稿
- 阅读AI摘要，包括决定和行动事项
- 一次提问涉及多个会议的问题
- 根据音频文件创建会议纪要、请求新的AI摘要、在群组之间移动纪要，或将纪要移至回收站

访问与隐私
Airepoto使用带PKCE的OAuth 2.1。每个请求的范围都限定于登录用户：服务器将访问令牌中经过验证的电子邮件声明解析为Airepoto成员，并拒绝任何缺少该声明的令牌。你只能查看自己的Airepoto账户已有权限访问的会议。删除会将纪要移至回收站，可从中恢复。

Airepoto是RSUPPORT Co., Ltd.提供的会议录音、转写和AI摘要服务。需要Airepoto账户。

payload.name: Product Listing Validator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Product Listing Validator checks whether product listing data includes the required fields before review or publishing. It returns a structured completeness result with present fields, missing fields, and validation errors, helping sellers and product teams quickly spot incomplete listing information.
payload.longDescription: Product Listing Validator 会检查商品刊登数据是否包含审核或发布前所需的字段。它会返回结构化的完整性结果，列出已有字段、缺失字段和验证错误，帮助卖家和产品团队快速发现不完整的商品信息。

payload.name: Browser Use
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use a secure cloud browser to research public websites, complete user-approved browser tasks, continue existing sessions, and watch the browser work live.
payload.longDescription: 使用安全的云端浏览器研究公开网站、完成用户批准的浏览器任务、继续现有会话，并实时观看浏览器操作。

payload.name: Nudges
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Just tell ChatGPT what to remember and when. Nudges confirms the exact time, then emails you the moment it's due. No app to install, no phone number, no cap on how many you set, and no paywall.

It understands the way you actually talk: "in 30 minutes," "tomorrow at 9," "every morning at 8," "every other Friday." Every reminder comes back with the exact local time and the inbox it's headed to, so you catch a mistake before it matters. Ask for your reminders any time, and cancel any one in a sentence.

Nudges is free and unlimited, and it reaches you in the inbox you already check. Your email is verified the moment you connect, so there's nothing to set up. We deliver reminders to that address and count basic usage events to run the service. We never store what your reminders say.
payload.longDescription:
只需告诉 ChatGPT 需要记住什么以及提醒时间。Nudges 会确认确切时间，到期后立即通过电子邮件提醒你。无需安装应用、无需电话号码、设置数量不限，也没有付费墙。

它能理解日常说法：“30 分钟后”“明天 9 点”“每天早上 8 点”“每隔一个星期五”。每条提醒都会再次确认准确的本地时间和发送目标收件箱，让你能在问题造成影响前发现错误。随时询问提醒事项，也可以用一句话取消任意一条。

Nudges 免费且不限量，会将提醒发送到你平时使用的收件箱。连接时会验证你的电子邮箱，因此无需额外设置。我们会向该地址发送提醒，并统计基本使用事件以运行服务。我们绝不存储提醒的具体内容。

payload.name: Twistly AI Presentation Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Twistly turns your ideas, notes, and documents into ready-to-edit PowerPoint presentations. Describe a topic, paste in text, or share a file (TXT, PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLS, or HTML), and Twistly builds a structured deck of up to 50 slides with clear layouts and matching visuals in seconds. Pick from 50+ templates to keep a consistent, on-brand look.
Everything comes out as a native, fully editable .pptx file, not a web export, so it opens cleanly in PowerPoint with no broken layouts. Edit it by hand like any normal presentation, or use the Twistly add-in for PowerPoint to keep refining and redesigning your slides. Nothing stays locked in a separate editor.
Used by students, educators, business professionals, and teams around the world.
payload.longDescription:
Twistly 可将你的想法、笔记和文档转化为可直接编辑的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。描述主题、粘贴文本或分享文件（TXT、PPTX、PDF、DOCX、XLS 或 HTML），Twistly 就会在几秒钟内制作出结构清晰、版式明确且配有相应视觉素材的幻灯片，最多可达 50 页。可从 50+ 个模板中选择，保持一致且符合品牌风格的外观。
生成的内容都是原生、完全可编辑的 .pptx 文件，而非网页导出文件，因此可在 PowerPoint 中顺畅打开，不会出现布局错乱。你可以像编辑普通演示文稿一样手动修改，也可以使用 Twistly PowerPoint 加载项继续完善和重新设计幻灯片。所有内容都不会被锁定在独立编辑器中。
全球各地的学生、教育工作者、商业人士和团队都在使用。

payload.name: PDF Translator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
1. Exclusive Side-by-Side View 
Instant Verification: Unlike native ChatGPT, our split-screen mode lets you compare original and translated text paragraph by paragraph for instant accuracy checks.
2. Preserve Original Layout 
Format Retention: Keeps tables, charts, and text layout perfectly structured so you can read with ease—no more broken formatting.
3. Global Language Support 
50+ Languages: Easily translate English to Spanish, French to German, and more with professional precision.
4. Download & Ready-to-Use 
Clean PDF Output: Get a downloadable, layout-preserved PDF instantly. No more copying raw Markdown text manually.

Ideal Use Cases: For business professionals, students, and researchers who need to translate contracts and papers without losing the original formatting.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect PDF Translator to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@PDF Translator ”.
Sample prompts: "@PDF Translator Translate this PDF to Spanish."
payload.longDescription:
1. 独家并排视图
即时核验：不同于原生 ChatGPT，我们的分屏模式让你可以逐段比较原文和译文，立即检查准确性。
2. 保留原始布局
格式保留：完整保持表格、图表和文本布局，让阅读轻松无碍，不再出现格式破碎。
3. 全球语言支持
50 多种语言：可将英语译成西班牙语、法语译成德语等，获得专业准确度。
4. 下载即用
整洁的 PDF 输出：立即获得保留布局、可下载的 PDF，无需再手动复制原始 Markdown 文本。
适用场景：适合需要在不丢失原始格式的情况下翻译合同和论文的商务人士、学生和研究人员。

在 ChatGPT 中使用
1. 连接应用：将 PDF Translator 连接到 ChatGPT。

2. 触发：输入“@PDF Translator ”。
示例提示：“@PDF Translator 将此 PDF 翻译成西班牙语。”。原文数值：1。

payload.name: Speechdub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Speechdub helps you import text into your document library, browse and edit saved documents, and generate natural speech with preset voices. Connect with a Speechdub API key from app.speechdub.com/settings/api. Creating documents uses your document quota; speech synthesis uses the same credit wallet as the web app.
payload.longDescription: Speechdub 帮助你将文本导入文档库、浏览和编辑已保存的文档，并使用预设语音生成自然语音。请使用 app.speechdub.com/settings/api 中的 Speechdub API 密钥进行连接。创建文档会占用你的文档配额；语音合成使用与 Web 应用相同的积分钱包。

payload.name: LIAM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LIAM is a personal memory assistant. It saves and recalls the facts, preferences, and notes you want to keep across conversations; stores and searches your contacts; keeps multi-step recipes and routines; and logs your meals and receipts with daily nutrition and spending summaries. You can type a request or just upload a photo — a receipt, a meal, a business card, or a note — and LIAM reads it and files it in the right place automatically (a restaurant receipt is logged as both an expense and a meal). Only extracted text/values are stored, never the raw image.
Example use cases
"Remember I prefer window seats on flights — tag it 'travel'."
"Who do I know at Nova Retail?" / "Add Sarah Chen from Acme as a contact."
"Log my lunch: chicken caesar salad" → "How much protein did I have today?"
"Log this receipt: Loblaws $87.43 groceries" → "How much did I spend today?"
Upload a business-card photo → contact created; upload a receipt photo → expense + meal logged.
payload.longDescription:
LIAM 是个人记忆助手。它会保存并回忆你希望跨对话保留的事实、偏好和笔记；存储和搜索联系人；记录多步骤食谱与日常流程；记录餐食和收据，并提供每日营养与支出摘要。你可以输入请求，也可以直接上传照片——收据、餐食、名片或笔记——LIAM 会读取并自动归档到正确位置（例如餐厅收据会同时记为支出和餐食）。只存储提取出的文本/数值，绝不保存原始图片。
示例用法
“记住我坐飞机喜欢靠窗座位——给它加上‘旅行’标签。”
“我在 Nova Retail 认识谁？”/“把 Acme 的 Sarah Chen 添加为联系人。”
“记录我的午餐：鸡肉凯撒沙拉”→“我今天摄入了多少蛋白质？”
“记录这张收据：Loblaws 杂货 $87.43”→“我今天花了多少钱？”
上传名片照片→创建联系人；上传收据照片→记录支出和餐食。

payload.name: Responsive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connects ChatGPT to Responsive so authenticated users can search approved company content, list and create Content Library Q&A, look up tags, collections, business units, required fields, and company users, create and inspect assigned projects, generate first-draft responses, run Answer Agent, manage project comments, create intakes, and update answer workflows inside Responsive.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Responsive。经过身份验证的用户可以搜索已批准的公司内容，列出和创建 Content Library 问答，查询标签、集合、业务部门、必填字段和公司用户，创建并查看分配的项目，生成初稿回复，运行 Answer Agent，管理项目评论，创建 intake，并在 Responsive 中更新答案工作流。

payload.name: MotionHub
payload.description: 通过 AI 管理 MotionHub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage media production projects with AI. Access tasks, scripts, calendars, boards, media files with transcripts and AI analysis, contacts, and team scheduling. Search footage using natural language to find clips by topic, speaker, or content — even when exact keywords don't match.
payload.longDescription: 借助 AI 管理媒体制作项目。访问任务、脚本、日历、看板、带转录和 AI 分析的媒体文件、联系人及团队排期。使用自然语言搜索素材，即使关键词不完全匹配，也能按主题、说话者或内容找到片段。

payload.name: Anchor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Anchor gives ChatGPT a shared drive where it can create files and organize them in folders. ChatGPT can read and write files in HTML, Markdown (MD), JSON, CSV, and other text formats, design typed tables, and query them with SQL. It can move files around, make copies, and keep everything organized. Every file, table, and folder it creates is shareable with your team, while Anchor handles storage, permissions, and versioning. Log in once, with no API keys and no setup, and ChatGPT only ever touches what you can access.
payload.longDescription: Anchor 为 ChatGPT 提供共享云盘，使其能够创建文件并按文件夹整理。ChatGPT 可以读写 HTML、Markdown（MD）、JSON、CSV 和其他文本格式的文件，设计具有明确字段类型的表，并用 SQL 查询。它可以移动文件、复制文件，并让一切保持有序。创建的每个文件、表和文件夹都可以与团队共享，Anchor 则负责存储、权限和版本管理。只需登录一次，无需 API 密钥，也无需配置，ChatGPT 只会访问你有权访问的内容。

payload.name: Fyrebox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fyrebox is a no-code interactive quiz and form builder for creators, marketers, and educators. The Fyrebox app lets users build and manage quizzes in their own Fyrebox account directly from ChatGPT. Users can create trivia, personality, assessment, and branching scenario quizzes from a prompt; edit questions, answers, scoring, and branching logic; customize colors, fonts, logos, backgrounds, lead-capture forms, and result pages; generate AI background images; start from templates; clone or delete quizzes; and review quiz responses.
payload.longDescription: Fyrebox 是无代码测验和表单构建器，可从提示创建问答、性格、评估和分支测验，编辑问题、评分和逻辑，自定义外观、获客表单和结果页，生成 AI 背景图、克隆或删除测验并查看回答。

payload.name: Meeting Mate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Meeting Mate helps users access and analyze meeting recordings, transcripts, summaries, and action items directly from ChatGPT.

Users can search conversations, review AI-generated summaries, retrieve action items, and gain insights from past meetings without leaving ChatGPT. Meeting Mate is designed for professionals who want quick access to meeting knowledge and follow-up information.

Key capabilities:

• Access meeting recordings
• Retrieve meeting transcripts
• View AI-generated summaries
• Review action items and decisions
• Search across conversations
• Extract insights from meetings
• Access meeting metadata and participant information

Meeting Mate works across online and in-person meetings and helps teams stay aligned by making meeting information easy to find and use.
payload.longDescription:
Meeting Mate 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中访问和分析会议录制内容、文字记录、摘要和行动事项。

用户可以搜索对话、查看 AI 生成的摘要、调取行动事项，并从过往会议中获取见解，无需离开 ChatGPT。Meeting Mate 专为希望快速访问会议知识和后续跟进信息的专业人士打造。

主要功能：

• 访问会议录制内容
• 调取会议文字记录
• 查看 AI 生成的摘要
• 查看行动事项和决策
• 搜索所有对话
• 从会议中提取见解
• 访问会议元数据和参与者信息

Meeting Mate 适用于线上和线下会议，让会议资料更易于查找和使用，帮助团队保持协同。

payload.name: COR
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: COR helps users manage their COR workspace from ChatGPT by finding clients, projects, tasks, collaborators, labels, attachments, and time logs, and by creating or updating projects, tasks, comments, attachments, collaborators, labels, and logged time.
payload.longDescription: COR 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 管理 COR 工作区：查找客户、项目、任务、协作者、标签、附件和工时记录，并创建或更新项目、任务、评论、附件、协作者、标签和已记录工时。

payload.name: Rosetta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rosetta helps users search, create, and organize private notes, reminders, and saved links, including their categories, tags, and lifecycle status.
payload.longDescription: Rosetta 帮助用户搜索、创建和整理私人笔记、提醒及已保存链接，包括其类别、标签和生命周期状态。

payload.name: Markdown by mdedit.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and save private Markdown documents in mdedit.ai directly from your conversation. Find and revise saved documents across your workspaces, then publish or unpublish a shareable link when you choose. Publishing always requires your explicit confirmation.
payload.longDescription: 直接在对话中于 mdedit.ai 创建并保存私密 Markdown 文档。可在各工作区查找和修改已保存文档，并在你选择时发布或取消发布可分享链接。发布操作始终需要你的明确确认。

payload.name: Dell Tech Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover your next opportunity with the Dell Tech Careers ChatGPT app!

Your smart, simple way to explore careers at Dell. Whether you’re an experienced tech professional, just starting out, or looking for a new direction, this app helps you find roles that fit your skills, goals, and lifestyle.

你的 Dell 未来，从这里启程！

payload.name: Smart Planner AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan your week, turn a goal into manageable steps, and coordinate work with family, friends, or a team. Smart Planner AI gives ChatGPT your tasks, planning preferences, progress, and eligible synced calendar context. Draft plans here, review them, and save only after approval.
